_meta.description: The one list of ACT codebases: GitHub repo, local checkout, Vercel projects, Supabase projects, domains. Replaces config/repos.json, config/act-core-repos.json and config/CODEBASES.md (archived 2026-09-25). Loaded and guarded by @act/projects (loadCodebases); check with `pnpm codebases:check`, and `-- --live` to compare with GitHub.
_meta.verified: 2026-09-25: repos and last push from `gh repo list`; Vercel project to repo from each project's latest production deployment (githubRepo, or source=cli where noted); Supabase project ids from the supabase.co URLs in each checkout's .env files; domains from the production deployment aliases.

tiers.platform: runs the organisation: command-center, scripts, wiki
tiers.product: an ACT product or project site, deployed and maintained
tiers.partner: built with or for a partner or community, deployed, lighter upkeep
tiers.tooling: developer and agent tooling, not deployed

_meta.project_links: Which project a codebase belongs to lives in config/project-codes.json (github_repo). Not duplicated here.

codebases.notes: Command-center, scripts, wiki. apps/command-center/.vercel links to a project named act-global-infrastructure that no longer exists; the live project is act-command-center.
